messages:
incidents-bot: Paging on-call: Severity=high for realtime-streaming. p95/p99 SLOs breached for SSE/WebSocket streaming (p95 ~1.8s, p99 ~6.4s). Investigating stalls/chunk delays. @oncall-rota please ack and take lead. :rotating_light:

oncall-rota: Acked. Taking lead. brief summary?

alex: seeing a surge starting ~10:12 UTC. CPU on proxy fleet normal, but write latencies to clients jump and we see a bunch of 504s from edge-proxy -> streaming-proxy. p95 token latency for hosted API route /v1/stream jumped from 0.28s -> 1.8s.

sana: logs show repeated `write failed: broken pipe` and `client read timeout` on streaming-proxy-2/3. Also a backlog of queued chunks in proxy stats.

mike: Prom query I ran: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(stream_write_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le))` — shows spike aligned with error window. p99 `stream_write_duration_seconds` spiking to 6s.

eva: customer impact: 3 paying customers in EU saw trailing chunks pause for ~30-60s, some experienced complete stream resets. We've got two support tickets saying transcripts truncated.

alex: reproducer: open SSE stream to /v1/stream with a long-running response and throttle client read to emulate slow consumer -> we see proxy accumulate buffered chunks then connection eventually gets reset with 504.

infra-bot: Deploy 6032.13 to streaming-proxy group completed at 10:10 UTC on 4 nodes. No obvious errors in deploy logs.

sana: hypothesis: proxy is hitting slowwrite path due to client backpressure + keepalive timeouts. Some nodes show backlog > 64k queued events. Also observed muxer threads stuck on epoll with high POLLOUT wait times.

oncall-rota: Action items for live mitigation: 1) Enable conservative backpressure handler to drop old prefix (graceful) on overloaded proxies. 2) Shorten proxy keepalive write timeout from 120s -> 30s for streaming route. 3) Shift 20% traffic to dedicated warm pool (fallback region). 4) Open incident ticket and inform CS. Assign Alex + Sana to own.

alex: starting traffic shift: flip route weight using `rb-router` command: `rb-router set-weight --route streaming --target warm-pool-eu --weight 20` -- running now.

sana: changing keepalive on streaming-proxy with remote config: `streaming.keepalive.write_timeout_seconds=30` then reload. Pushing to canary node first.

mike: monitoring dashboards: tail-latency graph shows p95 normalization on canary after ~18s of config change. Edge proxies still have some inflight backlog.

eva: notifying CS: "We're investigating streaming stalls impacting trailing chunks for some customers in EU. Mitigation in progress; short-term traffic reroute and proxy config change to reduce head-of-line blocking. Will follow up with full RCA."

oncall-rota: good. Alex confirm warm-pool shift took effect?

alex: router reports: warm-pool-eu receiving 20% of stream requests. I also disabled batching on affected route to reduce chunk coalescing: set `batch.max_size=1` for now.

sana: canary proxy shows reduced queued bytes from ~72k -> ~5k. No new `write failed` logs on canary. Rolling config to rest of proxies.

mike: metrics update: p95 dropped to 0.34s on canary and to 0.9s cluster-wide after 2m. p99 still elevated at ~2.1s for a subset of connections (likely long-slow clients).

eva: CS updated customers A,B,C with ETA: monitoring and follow-up within 2 hours. Tickets linked: #INC-4521, #INC-4522, #INC-4523.

oncall-rota: do we need a restart of any proxy processes or is config reload enough?

sana: reload seems sufficient for write-timeout change. For nodes with epoll stuck threads I recommend a rolling restart with 5min drain to avoid resetting healthy clients. Propose restart schedule: restart 1 node every 30s until done.

alex: started node restart on streaming-proxy-3 (10:28 UTC). Observed short reconnects for ~2% connections, but overall load improved.

infra-bot: Alert: increase in `stream_conn_reconnect_count` by +2.1% during restart window.

mike: ran a deeper log grep: `grep -E \"write failed|slowwrite|EPIPE|timeout\" /var/log/proxy/streaming-proxy-*.log | sed -n '1,200p'` — shows concentrated errors on two nodes that were handling more client-slow connections.

sana: root cause draft: under a client-slow spike, the proxy's chunk buffering + attempt to batch small writes into larger syscalls pushed socket write latencies into long tails. Combined with long keepalive default and a stale epoll bug in older kernel builds, some threads got stuck in POLLOUT wait. This caused backpressure upstream and eventually 504s and stream resets.

oncall-rota: mitigation status: keepalive timeout lowered and batching disabled (done), traffic shift to warm pool (done), rolling restarts in progress (ongoing). Any other mitigations?

alex: adding temporary rate-limiter for long-lived streaming connections per IP to protect proxies: `conn.limiter.duration=5m max_conns=10`. Pushing now.

eva: CS: customer B reporting improved behavior, transcript regeneration succeeded after we reissued session. Customer A still seeing occasional chunk reorder; investigating.

mike: we should also consider tuning `tcp_sndbuf` on proxy nodes as medium-term fix and verifying kernel patch for epoll anomaly.

sana: agreed. I'll open infra follow-ups: kernel upgrade + audit batching code path.

oncall-rota: assign follow-ups: Alex (traffic/route changes & warm pool rollback plan), Sana (proxy code + kernel follow-up), Mike (post-incident metrics and SLO calc), Eva (customer comms & tickets).

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-streaming-stall-eu. Severity=high. Start time=6032109999.

eva: summary for execs: "Streaming tail latency spike in EU affecting chunk delivery for a small subset of customers due to proxy slowwrite/backpressure. Mitigations applied (keepalive reduction, disable batching, traffic shift, rolling restarts). Customer impact limited but SLO windows breached for p95/p99 for ~12 minutes. Follow-up RCA and kernel/patch timeline TBD."

oncall-rota: last checks before we unpage: confirm p95 back to baseline across regions and p99 trending down.

mike: running Prom queries every 30s. Current cluster p95 0.32s, p99 1.1s and still falling.

sana: rolling restarts finished at 10:47 UTC. No further `epoll` stuck indicators.

oncall-rota: unpaging in 10. Will keep monitoring for 1 hour and escalate if regressions. Great job team. :tada:

eva: creating postmortem stub and linking incident ticket. Will collect logs/graphs and schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.

alex: note for postmortem: include reproduction steps, PromQL used, config diffs, kernel versions of affected nodes, and the code path for batching in streaming-proxy.

incidents-bot: Paging cleared by oncall-rota at 10:49 UTC."
